items.statement: The report validates claimed minima and transition states by frequency and endpoint/connectivity evidence, retaining object-specific IDs.
items.expected: Each retained minimum has zero imaginary frequencies; each claimed TS has exactly one and an endpoint/connectivity check.

items.statement: The report defines a consistent relative-free-energy reference and documents candidate coverage, rejection and stopping evidence.
items.expected: A reproducible reference and energy convention are stated, with candidate-level provenance and a concrete stopping/limitation record.

items.statement: The validated productive event has a reported activation free-energy barrier.
items.expected: The barrier is approximately 25.9 kcal/mol within the declared computational comparison convention.

items.statement: The known acetate product is thermodynamically stabilized relative to the path reference.
items.expected: The product relative free energy is approximately -20.2 kcal/mol within the declared convention.
